report:
Dashboard feed no longer respects FEED_PAGING_NUM setting

### Gitea Version

1.27.2

### What happened?

The feed in the dashboard view no longer respects the [ui] FEED_PAGING_NUM setting.
It only controls activity records in users' personal information.

Testing has found that it is now actually controlled by [ui.user] REPO_PAGING_NUM.
This should be incorrect. This parameter should only control the number of repository.

### How are you running Gitea?

docker

evidence.quote: The dashboard activity feed was paginated with `[ui.user] REPO_PAGING_NUM` instead of `[ui] FEED_PAGING_NUM`. The wrong setting was picked up when the page size was hoisted into a local variable in https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/34994 ... Fixes https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/38925
evidence.by: bircni (contributor, PR author; approved by wxiaoguang and TheFox0x7, merged by wxiaoguang (maintainer))

notes: One-line fix in routers/web/user/home.go: dashboard feed used the wrong paging setting (regression from #34994).

reviews.decidable_why: Body names the exact wrong setting; routers/web/user/home.go at 1.27.2 visibly uses REPO_PAGING_NUM for the feed.
